title: Recompose About, Contact and Experience with existing content
context: The owner asked for stronger design on the two existing pages. Their approved identity, timeline, theme counts and contact actions already provide the content for a more deliberate composition. The owner subsequently included Experience in the same design pass.
options: Keep the existing plain lists and adjust only their spacing.
Recompose the same content into a typographic opening, functional color panels and a visual decision-theme breakdown.
choice: Use static server-rendered layouts and existing tokens to give identity, chronology and contact actions distinct visual roles.
tradeoff: The richer arrangement has more CSS and requires browser checks of wrapping, focus and reflow. It adds no motion or dependency.
